messages:
maya (Design): Hey team — dropped a compact-table iteration for the Rules list into the preview. Trying to fit more rules on smaller screens while keeping keyboard nav obvious. PTAL: https://internal.redwood.dev/preview/123

ben (Product): Nice. Quick q: does compact mode collapse descriptions or just reduce row padding?

maya (Design): It reduces vertical padding, shrinks the rule badges, and switches the preview thumbnail to an icon-only mode. Descriptions are still accessible from an inline expand.

sam (Eng): Do we still have drag handle affordances for reordering in compact? Hard to hit small handles with touch.

maya (Design): Good call — added a 12px hit target around the handle and keyboard reorder shortcuts: `Ctrl+Cmd+↑` / `Ctrl+Cmd+↓` (docs in the preview).

elaine (A11y): Please put those kbd shortcuts in visible UI tooltips AND expose them in the accessibility help modal. Also the handle needs `aria-grabbed` state and a clear focus ring.

ben (Product): Also seeing intermittent validation toast when saving order — "Order conflict" — even though save succeeds. Could be debounce or backend lag.

sam (Eng): That sounds like the optimistic UI is racing with the assign-priority RPC. I'll add a 500ms debounce and make the toast only appear on explicit error.

maya (Design): For the preview panel, @ben, is the simulation reflecting prefix routing correctly? I noticed some flows show different match counts than the simulator.

ben (Product): Yeah we saw mismatches yesterday. They were caused by the simulator using an older ruleset cache. Will coordinate with infra to auto-invalidate on edits.

design-bot: Screenshot uploaded: compact-table-v3.png

elaine (A11y): Visual nit: the contrast on the tiny priority chip is barely AA at 14px. Can we bump weight, or use the reversed chip style when in compact mode?

maya (Design): I can try reversed chips for priorities 1-3 and keep outlined for lower tiers. Will mock two options.

sam (Eng): One more keyboard question — when you press space on a row to toggle active, do we trap focus in the expand panel? Currently focus escapes which is jarring.

maya (Design): Good catch. Intended behavior is to trap focus in the expanded details until you close with `Esc`. I'll fix.

ben (Product): Can someone add a short microcopy under the rules table: "Use compact mode to view more rules on small screens. Drag to reorder or use keyboard shortcuts." Keeps people from missing shortcuts.

elaine (A11y): Add an accessible name for the compact toggle: `aria-label="Toggle compact rules view"`. Also include `aria-pressed` state.

maya (Design): Will update mocks and push v3 tonight. Thanks everyone — once designbot posts the alternate mock I'll pick one and we can merge the small CSS tweaks + sam's debounce. :thumbsup:
